videos.title: R2AK 2028: For the love of the game
videos.description: For over a decade, Race to Alaska has quietly collected a drawer full of complaints about fairness, most of them pointing to one thing: human-powered teams racing for glory while everyone else raced for $10,000. So we opened the drawer. This playful investigation follows the race organizers as they dig into the grievances and roll out a brand new prize structure. Did they solve the problem? Not exactly. But they did reorganize it, trading one set of frustrations for an entirely new one.

videos.title: MILAMORE FINE JEWELRY
videos.description: We sat down with George in his SoHo home, followed him through the streets and subways of New York, and paired those moments with footage from his atelier in Japan. The result is a portrait of a designer whose work, like his story, moves between cultures, connecting the energy of the city with the patience and precision of traditional craft.

videos.title: Vinátta - Poulsbo 48 Hour Film Challenge
videos.description:
A sailor and his son set course for Poulsbo, Washington. Our submission for the 2025 Poulsbo 47.7 Hour Film Challenge, and the audience choice award winner! 

We were assigned our film parameters at 6 PM on Friday, February 28th, and had until 6 PM on Sunday to submit our final film.

Prop: A doughnut from Sluys Bakery
Location: Spice & Tea Exchange
Line: "This must be my lucky day"

Friday night after the opening event, we set sail to a nearby anchorage, choosing to capture the story chronologically on Saturday. Aside from a few quick pickups on Sunday, what you see in the film unfolded in the same order it was experienced. All the music was composed by Chad during filming. We had a great time–it felt less like a challenge and more like capturing the moments we’d be having anyway. 

We are incredibly grateful to everyone who felt the heart in our story. Winning the Audience Choice Award means the world to us.

videos.title: Silverwood School
videos.description: Silverwood School is an independent K-8 school in Poulsbo, Washington, where 85 students learn, play, and grow on a 17-acre campus in the woods. As the school geared up for its Annual Fund drive, they reached out to explore creating a video that would inspire their community to give.

videos.title: Seattle Credit Union with Jonah Coleman
Samsung Galaxy S6 - BTS
videos.description:
Behind the scenes look at director GMUNK's practical in-camera techniques used to showcase the Samsung Galaxy S6 Edge.

"The process for this clip was highly technical, as it was mostly executed using motion-controlled cinematography along with macro lenses using very short focus distances. We had to tightly synchronize these two major elements with an array of Laser Projectors. Add in the backlit LED screens shining through the acrylic lettering and you have a set full of expensive gear and a lot of moving parts."

videos.title: White Aspen Glamping
videos.description: For Stout Tent’s customer story series, we headed to Leavenworth, Washington to meet Brandy and her dad, Mike, who run a glamping getaway built around Stout tents. Rather than just film the setup, we stayed the night in one of their tents and got the full experience as guests. Spending that time with them gave the film an honest, firsthand feel for the business they’ve built together and the place they’ve made for others to enjoy.
